vt_hcl.title: High Crash Location Report: Sections and Intersections 2012-2016
vt_hcl.publisher: VTrans Office of Highway Safety, Data Section

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: VTrans' Severity Index prices each person killed ($1,500,000) and injured ($88,500) and each PDO crash ($11,300), NSC 2014 economic costs (HCL Report 2012-2016, PDF p. 12); VTrans' public crash data has no people counts, so per-crash costs can't be applied, and the figures are 2014 economic, not comprehensive

statewide_rates.missing: VTrans publishes statewide average rates by functional class (Summary Statewide Average Crash Rate 2012-2016, 1 page; e.g. urban principal arterial 5.1796 crashes/MVM), but they are 2012-2016 and CrashIQ has no Vermont AADT or functional class: not loaded

screening.state_method: High Crash Location: 5 or more crashes in 5 years and Actual/Critical rate ratio of 1.000 or more, critical rate against the statewide average for the functional class with K = 2.58 (VTrans HCL Report 2012-2016, PDF pp. 10-11)

min_years.missing: VTrans states no minimum; its HCL analysis period is 'Typically … 5 except where Roadway Improvements have occurred' (HCL Report 2012-2016, PDF p. 12)

spf_calibration.missing: no Vermont SPF calibration factors found (research 2026-11-08)
